title: Passive Voice: Processes and Reports
summary: Focus on the result or process when the agent is unknown or less important.
learningObjectives: Form passive structures in present, past and perfect tenses.
Decide when the agent can be omitted.
Avoid combining active and passive verb forms.

explanation.heading: Form
explanation.body: A passive consists of the appropriate form of be + past participle.

explanation.heading: Tense
explanation.body: The tense is expressed through be, including has/have been for present perfect passive.

explanation.heading: Agent
explanation.body: Use by when the agent matters; otherwise omit it.
explanation.example: The samples were processed by the analysis team.

examples.sentence: The measurements are recorded every minute.
examples.note: Present simple passive describes a process.
Past simple passive includes a finished time.
Present perfect passive emphasizes the current result.

commonMistakes.why: A finite passive requires an auxiliary.

studyTips: Use passive to describe reproducible procedures without repeating the agent.
Check whether the auxiliary agrees with the subject and time reference.

exercises.feedback: Present simple passive is are + past participle.
Past passive is was + past participle.

exercises.prompt: The report has ___ by the team.
exercises.feedback: Present perfect passive is has been + past participle.
Was calibrated is past simple passive.
Every Friday suggests present simple passive.
Past simple passive expresses a finished event.
The passive present perfect negative is has not been approved.

exercises.prompt: The measurements ___ (record) when the power failed.
exercises.feedback: Past continuous passive describes an ongoing action interrupted in the past.

exercises.prompt: Correct the sentence: The samples is collected every hour.
acceptedAnswers: The samples are collected every hour.
exercises.feedback: Samples is plural, so use are in the present simple passive.

exercises.prompt: Correct the sentence: The report has reviewed by the engineer.
acceptedAnswers: The report has been reviewed by the engineer.

exercises.prompt: Correct the sentence: The test performed yesterday.
exercises.feedback: Passive past simple requires was or were.

exercises.prompt: Correct the sentence: The instruments will calibrated tomorrow.
acceptedAnswers: The instruments will be calibrated tomorrow.
exercises.feedback: Future passive is will be + past participle.
